name: Saiin ~Namaiki na Onna-tachi no Naka e Sign-in!~
original_name: 催淫～生意気な女達の中へサインイン！～
source:
The protagonist tried to be a proper teacher, and forget about his hypnosis ability.
But getting annoyed and bullied by one of his students, Asakura Saori, he eventually lose control, and decide to take revenge on her with his ability.
translation:
主角试图成为一名合格的老师，而忘记了自己的催眠能力。
但遭到学生朝仓沙织的恼怒和欺负，他最终失去了控制，并决定用自己的能力向她复仇。
